====Noun====

# A [[device]] for [[transmit]]ting [[conversation]]s and other sounds in [[real time]] across [[distance]]s, now often a small portable unit also capable of running [[software]] etc.
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:phone}}
#: {{hypo|en|cell phone|speakerphone|clamshell phone|flip phone|mobile phone|smartphone}}
#: {{ux|en|Daragh's on the '''phone''' at the moment. He'll call you when he's finished.}}

#: {{ux|en|There's an old-fashioned '''phone''' in the doctor's waiting room - it doesn't work anymore, of course.}}
# {{lb|en|colloquial}} A person's [[telephone number]] (as a means of contact); [[digits]].
#* '''1994''', Warren G feat. Nate Dogg ''{{w|Regulate (song)|Regulate}}'' (song)

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|ambitransitive}} To [[call]] (someone) using a [[telephone]].
#: {{syn|en|call|phone up|ring|telephone}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Phone''' me as soon as you land at the airport.}}
#: {{ux|en|Her father told her to '''phone''' him to pick her up in case it started raining heavily.}}
#* {{RQ:Bramah Bravo of London|passage="You bloody fools!" shrieked Nickle, stung by a sudden dreadful inspiration, "we've let him '''phone'''. He has got through!"}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2010|author=Tyler Keevil|chapter=32|title=Fireball|location=Cardigan, Ceredigion|publisher=[[w:Parthian Books|Parthian]]|page=148|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/fireballbrightyo00tyle/page/148/mode/1up|isbn=978-1-906998-10-3|passage=It wasn’t like he was dying to get it off his chest. I think he only '''phoned''' because he knew how excited I’d be to hear about it.}}
#* {{quote-web|en|work=Skip Boring|date=2026-07-25|title=The Last Call of Jo-Anne Pedersen, the Girl Who Vanished From a Payphone|author=Nicholas Muhoro|url=https://skipboring.com/jo-anne-pedersen-vanishing-chilliwack-bc-payphone/|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260726151644/https://skipboring.com/jo-anne-pedersen-vanishing-chilliwack-bc-payphone/|text={{...|Angela later recalled him saying,}} “You’d better get here within half an hour, or I’m '''phoning''' the police.”}}
# {{lb|en|reporting verb}} To [[say]] via [[telephone]].
#* {{quote-book|en|title=Diary|author={{w|Lou Sullivan}}|date=23 Nov 1973|text=After I wrote the 23<sup>nd</sup> bout midnite Charles '''phoned''' he got my note + could I come over then?}}
